interpreted_intent: Requester asks for a surreal level 3 test within the ongoing independently randomized portrait-reference experiment. Independent alternatives compared an impossible receding doorway and a person standing beneath an arch; the inverted support relationship has a more immediate full-frame contradiction, subject presence and observable sole contact. The arcade, clothing and bodily arrangement are authorial choices, not requester facts. One impossible support relationship must lead the image; the readable ordinary street prevents a mere upside-down-camera interpretation. Preserve only visible face and short dark bob/fringe cues from the supplied reference, without inferring identity, age or personality. Subtle attraction comes from close attentive expression and light, with sensual 1, fetish 0, creativity 1 and surreal 3.
subject: A reference-guided woman in an inverted standing arrangement beneath a brick arch
setting: Sunlit brick arcade above an ordinary upright street
event: The woman stands with both soles attached to overhead masonry while her body extends downward
visual_priorities: Both feet and the inverted body form one clearly legible support chain under the arch
The ordinary upright street conflicts visibly with her inverted standing position
The reference face and bob remain recognizable at the chosen full-body projection
baseline_prompt_en: A surreal photographic scene led by an impossible support relationship. A woman resembling the supplied portrait stands upside down on the curved underside of a brick arcade: both shoe soles rest flush against the overhead masonry, her straight legs descend from those contacts toward her inverted torso, and her head hangs below her shoulders toward the ordinary street. This departure from ordinary gravity dominates the entire photograph. Frame her near the mouth of the arcade, large enough to recognize her face, with the arch sweeping across the top and a strip of upright street below. The lower street contains a vertical black lamppost, a pavement curb and the base of the opposite building, clearly establishing the ordinary world's upright direction. Her two feet occupy neighboring bricks on one shallow section of the arch, separated by a natural hip-width stance; the contact edges and both shoes remain visible against the pale mortar. Her body continues in one unbroken anatomical chain below them, arms relaxed beside her torso and hands open. Her dark bob falls gently toward the street, individual short strands and wispy fringe outlining her inverted face. Preserve the reference's visible facial proportions and dark eyes, with her face turned slightly toward the camera, an attentive gaze and a faint almost amused smile. She wears charcoal straight-leg trousers, simple black flat shoes and a soft ivory blouse whose loose hem hangs toward the street. The quiet closeness of her expression provides a subtle human attraction within the disorienting space. Use a portrait photograph from an upright camera on the arcade floor, a medium-wide lens and a nearly frontal view that keeps both sole-to-brick contacts, her face and the street's vertical markers simultaneously clear. Soft late-afternoon side light picks out brick texture and a warm contour along her cheek, with natural pores, believable fabric weight and crisp contact shadows. The entire composition turns around the contradiction between her inverted standing position and the normal street below.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Use the explicitly selected surreal level 3 so an impossible relationship leads the whole photograph; agent staging remains replaceable.
